name: ogenic-god-toolkit
description: Unified OGENIC capability router, execution broker, approval/verification layer, Control Tower UI, and Business/Sales workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Auto-route work across OGENIC capabilities, tools, connectors, and agents.
interface.longDescription: One OGENIC entry point that classifies the requested outcome, selects the minimum valid capability chain, delegates to connected tools or agents, applies approval gates, verifies results, and exposes a mobile-first Control Tower UX. Includes developer operations, data and knowledge, business and sales, communication, security, media, and observability.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OGENIC GOD TOOLKIT to understand my outcome, choose the right capability and execution surface automatically, perform the work when authorized, verify the result, and report Result / Blocked / Next.
